overall: No violation where the committee withheld Purpose 2 bargaining minutes while negotiations were still ongoing; the AG recommended release now that a contract is reached and flagged unrecorded purpose and roll-call votes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee withheld executive session minutes from collective bargaining sessions after the purpose for nondisclosure had expired.
allegations.key_passage: Even though negotiations have now concluded, we do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law because, at the time of the request for minutes, the Committee was still engaged in an ongoing collective bargaining negotiation.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the AG noted the minutes did not record the purpose for entering executive session or the roll-call votes to enter it.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Open Meeting Law requires that the votes be recorded by roll call and entered into the minutes.
